description.en:
Parishes  (socken/pitäjäs) are areas used in dialect research. These are close to the adminstrative borders in ca 1938. This dataset includes data for Finland area as in 1938.

Coordinate Reference System: ETRS89 / ETRS-TM35FIN (EPSG:3067)

creator: Institute for the Languages of Finland

values: Kotimaisten kielten keskus / Institute for the Languages of Finland
